_comment: Round 62: the value every SDK signs, and the server seals, when the owner adds or removes a webhook. It is sha256=<the SHA-256 of the address exactly as sent, as lowercase hex> kinds=<the types sorted and joined with commas, or all for none>. The owner's request key signs the change (subscribe or delete below) with this value as its subject, over the same preimage as a setting, so Verdifax cannot add a destination for the account's events. The record never holds the address. Every SDK reads this file in a test (R266).

cases.name: an empty list takes every kind
an address with a token, which the record never shows
a non-ASCII path is hashed as its UTF-8 bytes
